audit.what: False positive on the scanner_gaming lead: the only 'quality scan' text is a task prompt asking for SonarQube 'code quality scanning'. There is no hub-scanner stub.
audit.evidence: iac_agent/__init__.py:76 prompt text `Configure SonarQube for code quality scanning`; rubric at :630-648 is 7 regex/keyword heuristics, e.g. :170-210 check_terraform_syntax adds points for `provider "..." {`, `tags =`, etc. Our run: 15 rows, reward 0.055.
audit.user_impact: No fake data or stub. Note that the reward is pure keyword/regex counting with no execution or correctness check (terraform validate, ansible-lint), so it is gameable by keyword stuffing. Treat scores as style proxies.

gold_review.explanation: The answer is a task slug ("aws_vpc_subnets_igw_nat"), while all reward terms are keyword/structure heuristics over a full Terraform/Ansible write-up (syntax, best practices, completeness), so echoing the slug scores the same 0.055 baseline as garbage.
gold_review.evidence: probe answer "aws_vpc_subnets_igw_nat"; src iac_agent/__init__.py check_terraform_syntax/check_iac_best_practices/etc.; gold_raw.log reward r1: [0.055]*5 == garbage 0.055 (check_iac_best_practices 0.25, check_code_structure 0.05 for any text)
